seedMappingNotes: The 25/26 Nitro catalog labels the 157 value 1170 mm as running length. The seed effectiveEdge value 1170 mm is separately corroborated by retailer technical tables that label it effective edge; this cross-source mapping is explicit and is not asserted as a terminology equivalence by Nitro.
For the scalar sidecut field, the middle radius 7.3 m is retained for compatibility while the full manufacturer sequence is preserved in sidecutRadii.
variantDiscrepancy: Nitro Canada's 2026 product page lists a 157W variant, but the 25/26 catalog technical table does not list 157W (it lists 159W, 162W, 165W). No geometry is inferred for the unlisted 157W.

snowboardingProfiles.pageScope: Review has not been updated beyond the 2025 model; publisher explicitly says it needs a retest and only offers it as a possible proxy for 2026.
snowboardingProfiles.externalFlexNotes: Review lists medium-stiff 7/10 rating but describes on-snow feel as medium 6/10; neither replaces Nitro's current official 7/10 product flex scale or site editorial scores.
snowboardingProfiles.observations: The disclosed 2021 sample felt stable at speed, carved well, maneuvered adequately at slow speed, and handled bumps/crud reasonably; shallow powder was manageable but deep/extended powder was not its strength.
snowboardingProfiles.scoreDecision: Directional historical proxy only. It is not a 25/26 test, the page itself requests retesting, and its weighted score/subscales must not be mapped into the site's six dimensions. Keep current six scores as low-confidence estimates pending a documented target-season test.

leadsChecked.finding: Still explicitly says its review is not updated beyond model year 2025 and requests a retest. The disclosed physical sample is 2021 Team Camber, 157 cm, tested 2020-03-07; not evidence of the 25/26 product.
Lists/describes Nitro Team 2026 and discusses the altered tip/tail shape, but does not disclose a directly tested board, size, ride date, days or conditions; not treated as a test.
2026 buying guide describes Team 2026, but provides no sample identity or controlled ride-test disclosure; not treated as a target-season test.
Nitro's own 2026 Team preview describes the board and construction; manufacturer promotional material, not independent ride evidence.

The 2025-11-07 article claims a multi-day 157W test across groomers, powder and park, but identifies the sample as Team Wide BRD'25 (model/article name), gives no verifiable ride dates or resort, and is an Amazon-affiliate product page. It does not establish that the sample is the 2025/26 generation. Treat as an unverified prior/ambiguous-season lead only; do not transfer its observations or scores to the 2025/26 standard 157.

reviewSearch.decision: No newly located source justifies changing the six editorial values or upgrading confidence. The 2025-11-07 Team Wide article claims a 157W multi-day test but does not verify sample model year, resort or ride dates, and is not evidence for the target-season standard 157. Keep existing estimates and label all six low-confidence until a disclosed 25/26 sample test becomes available.
